creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-09-30: "msg should be instant? not just when idle?" Clarified 2026-10-03: "sometimes messages are just more urgent and you want agents to be able to message each other mid work".

Today (docs/cli/msg.md) an agent in a pane is rung only when it is idle or waiting with an empty prompt, so a post to a busy agent sits in the daemon until its turn ends. The opt-in hooks in extras/claude-code/messaging-hooks.json already hand a message over after every tool call, but nothing installs them by default.

The ask is an urgent post: the sender can say a message should not wait, and it then reaches a working agent mid-turn (Claude Code queues typed input and folds it into the running turn; the PostToolUse hook is the other route). Ordinary posts keep today's behavior. Must keep the existing guarantees: never type into a draft, a dialog, or over a person typing. Decide how urgency is spelled (a post flag, and whether a group policy can limit who may use it).
title: 📨 A message reaches a working agent, not only once it goes idle
